panels.title: LLM call distribution by model_name (24h)
panels.description: Stacked count of llm_interactions rows per model_name. Surfaces traffic shifts after the Phase 11.6 cutover and any unexpected fallback to OpenAI.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, COALESCE(model_name, 'unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM llm_interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$space_id' = '' OR space_id = '$space_id') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LLM latency p50 / p95 / p99 by task × model
panels.description: Per (task_name, model_name) percentiles over the selected range. Compare gpt-5.4-mini (cloud) vs mdemg-llm-v1 (local) per task.

targets.rawSql: SELECT task_name, COALESCE(model_name, 'unknown') AS model_name, COUNT(*) AS calls, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::int AS p50_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::int AS p95_ms, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::int AS p99_ms FROM llm_interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL AND ('$space_id' = '' OR space_id = '$space_id') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: LLM error rate % by task_name (selected range)
panels.description: Percentage of llm_interactions with non-null error per task_name. Spikes indicate timeout pressure, breaker trips, or model failure modes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT task_name, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN error IS NOT NULL AND length(error) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN error IS NOT NULL AND length(error) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS error_pct FROM llm_interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$space_id' = '' OR space_id = '$space_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY error_pct DESC NULLS LAST, calls DESC

panels.title: Open circuit-breakers (current count)
panels.description: Number of named circuit breakers currently in StateOpen. Counter is exported as mdemg_circuit_breaker_state{state="open"} — one series per breaker, summed here. With CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED=false the value should stay at 0; non-zero indicates a transient trip needing operator attention via /v1/admin/breakers/reset.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN labels->>'state' = 'open' THEN value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM metric_samples WHERE metric_name = 'mdemg_circuit_breaker_state' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND space_id = '$space_id'

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT space_id FROM llm_interactions WHERE time > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY 1
